crm_bridge.method: Ratio of loan-book originations to CRM inquiries over the same window, computed per lender.
crm_bridge.reason: The CRM and the loan book share no borrower or application identifier, so an inquiry cannot be traced to the loan it became. These ratios compare two independently counted populations and are directional only. They are not a conversion rate and should not be quoted as one.

partner_health.method: Weighted composite of six components, each rescaled to 0-100. Weights were chosen by judgment, not fitted to an outcome, and the components differ in reliability. Use it to rank where attention is needed, not as a rating.

metric_catalog.source: Maintained alongside the pipeline, one entry per published metric.

definitions.name: Originations
definitions.measures: Count of loans originated in the reporting window
definitions.caveat: Counts every loan the partner reported. Accuracy depends on partner data entry.

definitions.name: Disbursed
definitions.measures: Total capital deployed
definitions.caveat: Gross disbursement at origination. Not net of repayment or write-off.

definitions.name: Outstanding
definitions.measures: Principal still on the books
definitions.caveat: Sourced from partner aging sheets, whose formats vary. Blank origination dates cause rows to be excluded rather than silently zeroed.

definitions.name: Portfolio loans
definitions.measures: Loans currently active
definitions.caveat: Excludes repaid and charged-off loans.

definitions.name: Average loan size
definitions.measures: Mean disbursement per loan
definitions.caveat: A mean over a skewed distribution. The loan size bands on the same page are a better description of the spread.

definitions.name: Implied repaid
definitions.measures: Capital returned, estimated as a residual
definitions.caveat: An estimate, not a transaction total. No repayment records are collected, so this absorbs every reconciliation difference between the three inputs. Labeled as an estimate wherever it appears.

definitions.name: Months outstanding proxy
definitions.measures: Outstanding relative to disbursed, annualized
definitions.caveat: Named for what it computes. This is not days sales outstanding and should not be compared against DSO benchmarks.

definitions.name: Charge-off rate
definitions.measures: Written-off principal as a share of capital deployed
definitions.caveat: Totals reconcile to source. The denominator is lifetime disbursement, so a young portfolio will understate the eventual rate.

definitions.name: Trailing 12m charge-off rate
definitions.measures: Recent write-offs against lifetime disbursement
definitions.caveat: Numerator and denominator cover different windows by design. Useful as a trend, misleading as a level.

definitions.name: PAR 30
definitions.measures: Outstanding 30 or more days past due
definitions.caveat: Bands use exclusive upper bounds, so 30-59 means 30 to 59 inclusive of both ends and nothing at 60.

definitions.name: PAR 60
definitions.measures: Outstanding 60 or more days past due
definitions.caveat: See PAR 30 on band boundaries.

definitions.name: PAR 90
definitions.measures: Outstanding 90 or more days past due
definitions.caveat: The most reliable single distress signal here, because it is least sensitive to timing differences in partner reporting cycles.

definitions.name: Cohort charge-off rate
definitions.measures: Write-offs traced to the quarter of origination
definitions.formula: SUM(chargeoff_amount WHERE origination_quarter = Q) / SUM(disbursed WHERE origination_quarter = Q)
definitions.caveat: Each charged-off loan is attributed to the quarter it was originated, not the quarter it was written off. Recent cohorts are immature and their rates will rise.

definitions.name: Vintage curve
definitions.measures: Cohort charge-off rate against cohort age
definitions.caveat: Cohorts are compared at different ages. Only read across cohorts at comparable maturity.

definitions.name: Jobs
definitions.measures: Jobs created or retained, as reported by the borrower
definitions.caveat: Self-reported at origination and not verified afterward. A reported zero is counted as a reported value, not as missing.

definitions.name: Jobs per million deployed
definitions.measures: Job outcomes normalized by capital
definitions.caveat: Inherits the reliability of self-reported jobs. Comparable across partners only where loan sizes are similar.

definitions.name: Advisory businesses
definitions.measures: Businesses receiving technical assistance
definitions.caveat: Counts businesses advised, most of which never borrow. Do not divide into loan counts as though advisory were a lending funnel.

definitions.name: Advisory hours per business
definitions.measures: Depth of advisory support
definitions.caveat: Partner definitions of a billable advisory hour differ.

definitions.name: Minority-owned share
definitions.measures: Unique borrowers in any minority category
definitions.formula: COUNT(loan WHERE race IN minority OR ethnicity = hispanic) / eligible_rows
definitions.caveat: A row-level OR, counted once per borrower. Summing the race columns and adding ethnicity double-counts anyone recorded in both; the naive sum is shown on the quality page so the gap is visible.

definitions.name: Women-owned share
definitions.measures: Share of borrowers reporting women ownership
definitions.caveat: Denominator is rows that reported, not all rows. Coverage is shown next to the share and should be read with it.

definitions.name: LMI share
definitions.measures: Share of borrowers in low-to-moderate income areas
definitions.caveat: A partner that does not collect income band is reported as missing, never as 0%. Those two look identical on a chart and mean opposite things.

definitions.name: Demographic coverage
definitions.measures: Share of eligible rows with a value recorded
definitions.caveat: Partners that do not collect a field are excluded from both numerator and denominator, so they cannot drag coverage down as though they had answered.

definitions.name: Rolling 12-month originations
definitions.measures: Originations over the trailing year
definitions.caveat: Built on a complete calendar spine. Months with no activity are retained as zero so the window is always twelve months wide.

definitions.name: Quarter-over-quarter change
definitions.measures: Change against the immediately prior quarter
definitions.caveat: A single-quarter comparison is noisy. Read with the trailing average.

definitions.name: Velocity signal
definitions.measures: Latest quarter against the trailing four-quarter average
definitions.caveat: Bands are accelerating above 110%, steady 90-110%, softening 70-90%, contracting below 70%. The current quarter may be partially reported.

definitions.name: Projected originations
definitions.measures: Linear extrapolation of the quarterly series
definitions.formula: OLS(originations ~ quarter_index), projected two quarters forward
definitions.caveat: A straight line through past quarters. It has no knowledge of pipeline, capital availability or partner onboarding, and is shown to indicate direction only.

definitions.name: Partner concentration (HHI)
definitions.measures: Herfindahl index over partner disbursement share
definitions.caveat: Above 1500 indicates moderate concentration, above 2500 high. Measures the lender mix, not borrower or sector concentration.

definitions.name: Top partner share
definitions.measures: Largest lender's share of capital deployed
definitions.caveat: Flagged above 30%.

definitions.name: Top three state share
definitions.measures: Geographic concentration of capital
definitions.caveat: Reflects partner footprints as much as demand. A lender operating in one state concentrates the portfolio there by construction.

definitions.name: Pre-screen inquiries
definitions.measures: Applications entering the funnel
definitions.caveat: Counts inquiries, not applicants. One business may inquire more than once.

definitions.name: Approval rate
definitions.measures: Approved as a share of all inquiries at a lender
definitions.caveat: Denominator includes inquiries still in progress, so the rate on recent months will rise as they resolve.

definitions.name: Unassigned rate
definitions.measures: Inquiries never routed to a lender
definitions.caveat: Mostly inquiries abandoned before the pre-screen completed. A rising rate is a funnel problem, not a credit one.

definitions.name: Originations per inquiry
definitions.measures: Directional bridge between CRM and loan book
definitions.formula: COUNT(origination) / COUNT(application) over the same window
definitions.caveat: The CRM and the loan book share no identifier, so no inquiry can be traced to the loan it became. This compares two separately counted populations over the same window. It is not a conversion rate.

definitions.name: Demand and supply lag
definitions.measures: Inquiry volume against originations at 0, 3 and 6 months
definitions.caveat: A visual alignment of two independent series. Any apparent lead or lag is descriptive and does not establish that inquiries caused originations.

definitions.name: Source freshness
definitions.measures: Age of each partner submission
definitions.caveat: Flagged past 35 days. Measures when the file was last written, not when its contents were last correct.

definitions.name: Partner health score
definitions.measures: Weighted composite of deployment, credit and reporting
definitions.caveat: A composite of measures with different reliabilities, on an arbitrary scale, with weights chosen by judgment. Useful for ranking attention, not for external reporting.

definitions.name: Board-ready status
definitions.measures: Whether the page can be certified without qualification
definitions.formula: NOT EXISTS(check WHERE severity = blocking AND status = fail)
definitions.caveat: Blocking means the figure would be wrong. A page can be funder-ready while carrying warnings that need a footnote.
